long_biography.plain_text:
Australian investor Roy Medich trained in hotel management before taking charge of Liverpool's Regal Theatre at twenty. His family's cinemas had introduced him to the business of public entertainment. Decades later, he backed the Medich Foundation's commitment to a cinema at Powerhouse Parramatta, arguing that Western Sydney communities should have direct access to major cultural experiences.

The foundation's partnership provides for an accessible screening room and a film programme supporting new work and emerging filmmakers. Medich has also supported Western Sydney University's medical research scholarships. The foundation subsequently redirected that scholarship support towards doctoral candidates researching cancer, giving the programme a more specialised research focus.
